topic: remove odor from smelly sports gear or gym bag
core_question: How do I get rid of persistent odor in sports equipment or a gym bag? (secondary: How do I remove pills/fuzz balls from a sweater without damaging it?)
answer_summary: Soak or wipe washable gear in a white vinegar solution or sprinkle baking soda, scrub, rinse, and air dry completely in a ventilated area since trapped moisture breeds odor bacteria.; after the topic shift: Lay the sweater flat and gently run a battery-powered fabric shaver or sweater comb over the fabric in one direction to shave off pills without snagging threads.
